pages.text: Craft $(item)Glider Wings$(), then the Hang Glider. Right-click to engage, jump off high ground, sneak to dive.$(br2)Overworld daytime thermals give lift; rain can sink you. Press $(thing)V$() for the variometer.
Right-click a $(item)Paint Can$() while holding the glider to paint its sail. One dose per coat; the frame stays wood.
